subject: Use when working with Printify — the print-on-demand REST API, catalog model (blueprints, print providers, variants,…

evals.prompt: Define printify in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the printify skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.
Describe the mental model or main primitives behind printify. Keep it operational rather than just naming the topic.
A user asks: "Generate the artwork PNG file that gets uploaded as a print file". Should printify activate? Explain the boundary and name the better owner when possible.
evals.negative_expectation: Must not force printify onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to webhook-integration, api-design, shopify.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "Create a Printify product from a blueprint + print provider + variant set and publish it to a connected Shopify store". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying printify.
Place printify among its adjacent skills (webhook-integration, api-design, shopify). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
evals.negative_expectation: Must not collapse related skills into interchangeable names; ownership must be mechanism-level.

evals.prompt: Name one plausible misconception about printify and correct it with a mechanism-level explanation.
